title: Exposure

{{status

| type                   = Debuff

{{status

'''Exposure'''s are [[debuff]]s that lower a specific elemental [[resistance]]. 

==Mechanics==
Multiple Exposures of the same element do not stack; only the strongest Exposure per element applies. Exposures of different elements can apply to the same target.

Exposure debuffs inflicted by the player or their skills apply -10% to the affected resistance by default. This base value can be overridden by certain effects and skills: 
* {{psl|Elemental Equilibrium}}: -25% for each element a hit didn't deal the damage type of
* {{il|Scorching Ray}}: -25% to Fire Resistance
* {{il|Frost Bomb}}: -15% to Cold Resistance
* {{il|Wave of Conviction}}: -15% to the Elemental Resistance matching the highest damage taken

Exposures inflicted by ''enemies'' generally apply -25% to the corresponding element,<ref>https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3326350#p24837298/</ref> though specific monster skills may override this. The Frost Bomb created by the Suffering [[Essence]] modifier applies a -30% cold exposure, for example. 

If Exposure has a duration (e.g. it doesn't apply to [[nearby]] enemies), it defaults to 4 seconds. If a skill sets the Exposure's duration, modifiers to skill effect duration will apply to the Exposure.

==Active skill gems==
The following [[skill gem]]s are related to Exposure:
{{Drop enabled gem table
|tables=skill_stats_per_level
|join=skill._pageID=skill_stats_per_level._pageID
|where = items.class_id="Active Skill Gem"
  AND (skill.description LIKE "%exposure%"
    OR skill.description LIKE "%drench%"
    OR skill_stats_per_level.id LIKE "%exposure%")
}}

==Support skill gems==
The following [[support gem]]s are related to Exposure:
{{Drop enabled gem table
|tables=skill_stats_per_level
|join=skill._pageID=skill_stats_per_level._pageID
|where = items.class_id="Support Skill Gem"
  AND (skill.description LIKE "%exposure%"
    OR skill_stats_per_level.id LIKE "%exposure%")
}}

==Items==
===Base items===
The following base items are related to Exposure:
{{Drop enabled base item table
|where=items.stat_text LIKE "%Exposure%"
  AND items.class_id NOT IN ("Active Skill Gem", "Support Skill Gem")
|large=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}

===Unique items===
The following [[unique item]]s are related to Exposure:
{{Drop enabled unique item table
|where = items.stat_text LIKE "%exposure%"
     AND items.stat_text NOT LIKE "%Exposure%Therapy%"
|large=1
|base_item=1
|level=1
|stat=1
}}

==Modifiers==
The following [[modifier]]s are related to Exposure:
{{Query spawnable modifiers
|where=mods.stat_text LIKE "%Exposure%"
       AND mods.stat_text NOT LIKE "%Exposure%Therapy%"  AND mods.generation_type NOT LIKE "10"
|stat_text=1
|spawn_weights=1
|level=1
|tags=1
|generation_type=1
}}
